title: System by Dave client edition manifest
description: One client edition: brand, surfaces, visibility, products with expected version ranges, and profile selections. A client configures products; it never modifies product source. See docs/client-framework.md. Descriptive only in v1: the build does not read this file yet.

id.description: Stable client ID. Used as the storage namespace root and in profile paths. Resolved at build time from the served surface; never read from a URL.

storagePrefix.description: Root of every browser-storage key this client's products own: <storagePrefix>.<product>.v<N>. Existing legacy keys are listed per product in storage.legacyKeys.

publisherCredit.description: Whether System by Dave branding appears in the shell. 'none' is a white-label edition (FMP struck publisher branding deliberately; see docs/public-shell-contract.md).

surfaces.description: Where the edition is served. A surface is a domain plus its visibility tier; one client can have several.

tier.description: public: indexed. public-unlisted: served openly, noindex and robots-disallowed. private: behind the edge access gate. Tier is per surface; v1 has no per-user or per-page permissions.

domainSiteId.description: The matching site id in scripts/domain-sites.json while that file remains the build's source of truth.

products.description: Products enabled for this edition, keyed by product id (products/<id>/product.json).

expectedVersionRange.description: A CI validation gate, not a build instruction. The pipeline builds exactly one version of each product; the build fails when that version falls outside this range. v1 never serves different versions of a product to different clients.

config.description: Validated against the product's configSchema. Anything the schema does not accept is rejected; a client cannot add behaviour the product does not already support.

external.description: Sources owned by another repository and delivered as a managed export. The client edition references them; this repository never hand-edits their output.

contract.description: Repository doc that governs the export.
